display_fil:
Kaso: Bumagsak ang isang adult sa waiting area
Hindi tumutugon kapag kinakausap
Nag-alok ng matamis na inumin ang kamag-anak
display_en:
Case: An adult collapses in the waiting area
Does not respond when spoken to
A relative offers a sweet drink
narration_fil: Bumagsak ang isang nasa hustong gulang sa waiting area at hindi tumutugon. Nag-alok ng matamis na inumin ang kamag-anak.
narration_en: An adult collapses at the waiting area and does not respond when spoken to. A relative offers a sweet drink.

display_fil:
Suriin ang paligid, tugon at normal na paghinga
Humingi agad ng emergency help at sanay na assessor
Hindi normal ang hinga: sundin ang natutunang CPR/AED
Humihinga: bantayan hanggang dumating ang tulong
display_en:
Check scene safety, response and normal breathing
Activate emergency help; request trained assessment
Not breathing normally: follow local CPR/AED training
Breathing: keep watching until help arrives
narration_fil: Suriin ang paligid, tugon at normal na paghinga. Humingi agad ng emergency help at sanay na assessor. Kung hindi normal ang paghinga, sundin ang natutunang CPR/AED; kung humihinga, bantayan hanggang dumating ang tulong.
narration_en: Check scene safety, response and normal breathing. Activate emergency help and request trained assessment. If not breathing normally, follow the locally trained CPR/AED response; if breathing, keep watching until help arrives.

display_fil:
Ano ang unang tugon?
Pumili bago basahin ang paliwanag.
display_en:
What is the first response?
Choose before reading the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Hindi tumutugon ang adult at may dalang matamis na inumin ang kamag-anak. Ano ang uuna?
check.prompt_en: The adult does not respond and the relative brings a sweet drink. What comes first?

options.fil: Painumin ng matamis na inumin baka mababa ang asukal niya.
options.en: Help her sip the sweet drink in case her sugar is low.

options.fil: Humingi ng tulong at suriin ang paghinga.
options.en: Activate help and check her breathing.

options.fil: Hayaan munang magpahinga at tingnan kung magigising.
options.en: Let her rest a few minutes to see if she wakes up.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Huwag bigyan ng pagkain, kendi o tubig ang hindi tumutugon, at hindi masasabi ng iisang palatandaan ang sanhi. 2: Tama. Kapag ligtas ang paligid, humingi ng emergency help at suriin ang tugon at normal na paghinga. 3: Naaantala ang pagtawag kapag naghintay. Tumawag na at patuloy na magbantay.
check.feedback_en: 1: Do not give food, candy or water to an unresponsive person, and one clue cannot tell the cause. 2: Right. Once the scene is safe, activate emergency help and check response and normal breathing. 3: Waiting delays emergency activation. Call now and keep watching.

narration_fil: Piliin muna ang sagot. Pagkatapos, basahin ang paliwanag sa bawat pagpipilian.
narration_en: Choose an answer first. Then read the explanation for each option.

display_fil:
Ligtas ang paligid; walang sagot sa tanong
May tumawag sa kumpirmadong contact
Sinuri ng BHW ang normal na paghinga
Sa kamag-anak: walang ipaiinom
display_en:
Safe scene; no answer to "Can you hear me?"
Someone calls the confirmed contact
The BHW checks for normal breathing
To the relative: nothing by mouth
narration_fil: Tiniyak ng BHW na ligtas ang waiting area, saka nagtanong: "Naririnig n'yo po ba ako?" Walang sagot. Nagpatawag siya sa kumpirmadong contact at sinuri ang normal na paghinga. Sinabi niya sa kamag-anak: "Walang ipaiinom habang hindi siya tumutugon." Kung hindi normal ang paghinga, susundin niya ang natutunang CPR/AED. Kung normal, babantayan niya hanggang dumating ang tulong.
narration_en: The BHW checks that the waiting area is safe, then asks, "Can you hear me?" There is no answer. She has someone call the confirmed contact and checks for normal breathing. To the relative she says, "Nothing by mouth while she cannot respond." If breathing is not normal, she follows her local CPR/AED training; if it is, she keeps watching until help arrives.

display_fil:
Walang pagkain, kendi o tubig sa hindi tumutugon
Huwag hulaan ang sanhi mula sa iisang palatandaan
Huwag ipagpaliban ang pagtawag
display_en:
No food, candy or water for an unresponsive person
Do not guess the cause from one clue
Do not delay emergency activation
narration_fil: Huwag bigyan ng pagkain, kendi o tubig ang taong hindi tumutugon. Huwag hulaan ang sanhi ng pagbagsak mula sa iisang palatandaan, at huwag ipagpaliban ang pagtawag.
narration_en: Do not give food, candy or water to an unresponsive person. Do not infer the cause of collapse from a single clue or delay emergency activation.

display_fil:
Mapilit ang kamag-anak sa inumin
Subukan bago tingnan ang paliwanag.
display_en:
The relative insists on the drink
Try before viewing the explanation.

check.prompt_fil: Parating na ang tulong at humihinga siya. Mapilit ang kamag-anak sa inumin. Ano ang gagawin ng BHW?
check.prompt_en: Help is on the way and she is breathing. The relative insists on the drink. What should the BHW do?

options.fil: Tanggihan ang inumin at magbantay hanggang dumating ang tulong.
options.en: Decline the drink and keep watching until help arrives.

options.fil: Payagan ang isang higop, dahil kusa naman siyang humihinga ngayon.
options.en: Allow one small sip, since she is breathing on her own now.

options.fil: Sabihin sa tulong na mababang asukal ang sanhi para magdala ng kendi.
options.en: Tell help the cause is low sugar, so they bring candy.

check.feedback_fil: 1: Tama. Hindi pa rin siya tumutugon kaya walang ipaiinom; habang humihinga, bantayan hanggang dumating ang tulong. 2: Humihinga siya pero hindi pa rin tumutugon. Huwag bigyan ng pagkain, kendi o tubig. 3: Huwag hulaan ang sanhi mula sa iisang palatandaan. Iulat ang nakita.
check.feedback_en: 1: Right. She still cannot respond, so nothing by mouth; while she breathes, keep watching until help arrives. 2: She is breathing but still unresponsive. Do not give food, candy or water. 3: Do not infer the cause from a single clue. Hand over what you observed.

narration_fil: Balikan ang kuwento. Piliin ang angkop na susunod na hakbang.
narration_en: Return to the story. Choose an appropriate next step.

display_fil:
Sa Lunes:
Ligtas na humingi ng tulong
Obserbahan ang tugon at paghinga
Mag-handover nang walang ipinaiinom
display_en:
On Monday:
Activate help safely
Observe response and breathing
Hand over without giving anything by mouth
narration_fil: Sa Lunes, gamitin ang kaparehong checklist sa bagong kathang-isip na kaso. Itala ang nakita at kung sino ang tatawagan. Ipakita ang ligtas na pagtawag, obserbasyon sa tugon at paghinga, at handover nang walang pagpapainom.
narration_en: On Monday, use the same checklist with a new fictional case. Record observations and the confirmed contact. Demonstrate safe activation, response/breathing observation and an appropriate handover without oral intake.
